lifexp.config.title: LIFE-XP Challenge — Settings
lifexp.config.presets.description:
Press a button to apply a ready-made preset.
The config will be overwritten and saved automatically.
The settings screen will reload to display the new values.
lifexp.config.preset.core.desc:
Start with 1.0 HP (0.5 hearts), slowed movement.
maxLevel: 1000. Dynamic fog enabled.
Oxygen bonus at start, burns less.
For true hardcore players.
lifexp.config.preset.vanilla_plus.desc:
Start with 6.0 HP, light buffs in late game.
maxLevel: 500. No fog.
Balanced mode for regular gameplay.
lifexp.config.preset.baby_mode.desc:
Start with 20.0 HP, massive buffs.
maxLevel: 200. No fog.
For those who just want to have fun.
lifexp.config.preset.real_hardcore.desc:
Start with 1.0 HP (0.5 hearts), reduced speed and attack.
maxLevel: 10000. Aggressive fog.
Burns very long, suffocates faster.
For the truly insane.
lifexp.config.general.max_level.desc:
XP level at which all attributes reach endValue.
midValue is applied at half this value.
lifexp.config.general.death_xp_tax.desc: Portion of player's total XP dropped upon death (0.0 to 1.0, without vanilla 100 XP limit).
lifexp.config.general.death_coords.desc: Send death coordinates directly to the player in chat upon dying.
lifexp.config.general.fog.desc:
Custom fog that depends on XP level.
At low levels the fog is dense, at high levels it clears.
When distance < 15 blocks, fog color is forced to black.
lifexp.config.general.fog.enable.desc:
Toggle dynamic fog based on XP level.
When off, vanilla fog is used.
lifexp.config.general.fog.start.desc: Fog render distance (in blocks) at XP level 0.
lifexp.config.general.fog.mid.desc: Fog render distance (in blocks) at maxLevel / 2.
lifexp.config.general.fog.end.desc: Fog render distance (in blocks) at maxLevel (cap).
lifexp.config.attr.mid.desc: Attribute modifier at XP level maxLevel / 2.
lifexp.config.attr.end.desc: Attribute modifier at XP level maxLevel (cap).
